scenarios.name: Show a clean full-width Home workspace on startup without empty document docks

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is launched without opening a document
the Get Started tab is selected alongside the Tools tab
the Home left rail displays New Part, New, and Open actions
document-only side docks such as Model, Material Browser, and Appearance Browser are hidden
the Recent list occupies the remaining workspace width with readable columns
the application title bar displays the application title without an inactive document name

scenarios.name: Preserve consistent Home chrome when switching to Home from an open document

scenario_steps.name: the user selects the Home document tab
document-only side docks are hidden and the Recent list spans the workspace
the ribbon shows the Home-context Get Started and Tools tabs with its display controls intact
the Home left rail shows the same New Part, New, and Open actions as cold startup
the application title bar reflects Home rather than the inactive part document
the status bar clears document viewport zoom telemetry
the user selects the open part document tab again
the part's docked panels, ribbon tabs, title bar, and viewport telemetry are restored
